build_concatbert_model: build a ConcatBERT model that concatenates BERT text and visual embeddings for multimodal classification
build_concatbow_model: build a ConcatBoW model that concatenates bag-of-words text and visual embeddings for classification
build_latefusion_model: build a LateFusion model that averages independent text and modal classifier scores
review_fusionbase_forward: review the FusionBase forward method that encodes text and modal inputs then flattens them
refactor_concatbert_freeze: refactor ConcatBERT to selectively freeze text or modal encoder parameters during training
